description: Policy-like 300-page document from Ironvale Specialty Insurance Company: declarations on pages 1 to 3, form pages, endorsements from page 210, schedules from page 279. General aggregate limit repeats on three pages with one value. The Declarations deductible ($1,500) is replaced by Endorsement No. 27 on page 261 (truth is the amended $7,500). The coverage territory runs across pages 14, 15 and 16, so no single 15-page window without overlap holds it whole. Absent field (must return null): am_best_rating.
